name: René Repasi - Après le § 1 - Am 3
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text: 1 b. Considers that the proposal on the 28th regime should be accompanied by recommendations on the introduction of a minimum charter of social rights applicable to all S.EUs, ensuring, inter alia, effective compliance with Union and national rules on workers’ protection and rights; stresses the need to consider the establishment of control mechanisms and effective penalties in the event of violations and that those rights cannot under any circumstance be circumvented or reduced by relying on the 28th regime;
